messages.content: What SACCO strategies should I use to beat inflation?

As your Financial Literacy Coach, I recommend setting aside at least 20% into an interest-bearing Tier-1 SACCO or money market fund (MMF) before discretionary spending. In Kenya, compounding 10-14% p.a. through licensed SACCOs preserves your capital far better than passive bank accounts. What is your current monthly saving target?
